# docker_compose_projects (Data Source)

Lists the compose projects on the daemon, like `docker compose ls`: containers grouped by the `com.docker.compose.project` label, each with a status such as `running(2), exited(1)` and its config files.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "docker_compose_projects" "all" {
  all = true
}

output "projects" {
  value = data.docker_compose_projects.all.names
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `all` (Boolean) Include projects whose containers are all stopped (CLI `--all`). Default `false`.

### Read-Only

- `content_sha256` (String) Hex SHA-256 of `projects_json`.
- `docker_server_version` (String) Docker Engine version of the daemon.
- `engine_api_version` (String) Engine API version negotiated with the daemon.
- `names` (List of String) The project names, sorted.
- `projects` (Attributes List) Compose projects found on the host, grouped by the project label. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--projects))
- `projects_json` (String) JSON array as `docker compose ls --format json` prints it.

<a id="nestedatt--projects"></a>
### Nested Schema for `projects`

Read-Only:

- `config_files` (String) Upstream `ConfigFiles`.
- `name` (String) Upstream `Name`.
- `status` (String) Upstream `Status`.
